faqs.q: What is the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) used for?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) is a ratchet strap listed in 3 end-fitting and length versions in 1″ webbing. A ratchet strap is a webbing tie-down with a ratchet tensioner and end fittings, used to secure loads in transport. It holds cargo, equipment and pipe on flatbeds, trailers and in containers, tensioned with the ratchet. It is load-securing equipment, not lifting gear. Browse the range on our [ratchet straps and tie-downs shelf](/c/ratchet-straps-tie-downs).

faqs.q: What sizes does the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) come in?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) comes in 3 end-fitting and length versions in 1″ webbing. The table starts at 1″ (800 kg minimum breaking load) and runs up to 1″. Available as endless, double j hook, S hook. Every size has its own Indus part number, with its dimensions in the size table. If your size is not listed, send the load, pin or rope size and we will confirm what fits.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm)?
faqs.a: Pick the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) on the rated load for the pull you will actually apply, then check the anchor points, rails and cargo it must hold. Choose on the lashing capacity or working load limit on the label, use enough straps for the load, and protect the webbing from edges. The smallest listed is 1″ (800 kg minimum breaking load). See our [ratchet strap guide](/blog/ratchet-strap-vs-chain-and-binder) for more.

faqs.q: What load rating does the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) have?
faqs.a: The manufacturer lists a minimum breaking load of 800 kg for the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm); its 2:1 design factor puts the working load limit at half that figure. A minimum breaking load is a test figure and must not be used as a working limit; a working load limit is confirmed with the quotation. It is rated for tension, lashing or fixing, not for overhead lifting.

faqs.q: What part number do I quote for the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm)?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number from the size table, for example IH-LR-RS-RS125M-100-E for the endless version or IH-LR-RS-RS125M-100-SH for the s hook version. Add the quantity and, if you need more than the standard paperwork, say so on the request. If you only know the load and the pin or rope size, send those and we will match the part number.

faqs.q: How does the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) compare with the Ratchet Strap — 2″ (50 mm)?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) and the Ratchet Strap — 2″ (50 mm) belong to the same family but differ in webbing width, so their ratings and fit are not interchangeable. The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) is listed in 3 end-fitting and length versions in 1″ webbing. Compare the rating or size marked on each part, not the name, before substituting one for the other. See the [Ratchet Strap — 2″ (50 mm)](/p/ratchet-strap-2in-50-mm) for its own sizes.

faqs.q: What material and finish does the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) have?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) is made from Polyester. Tell us the working environment if you need a different material or finish.

faqs.q: What standard and certificate come with the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm)?
faqs.a: For the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm), the manufacturer states: Rated with a 2:1 design factor between working load limit and minimum breaking load. Ask on your request for any documents you need, such as a test certificate.

faqs.q: What can the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) be connected to?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) works with vehicle anchor points, rails, D rings and similar fittings; match the strap width to its end fittings and anchor points. Check the anchor points are rated for the lashing load. Protect the webbing from sharp edges with corner protectors. Related: [load binders](/c/load-binders).

faqs.q: How should the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) be inspected and used?
faqs.a: Inspect the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) before every use and discard it if the webbing is cut, frayed, burnt or chemically damaged, or the ratchet or end fittings are bent or worn. It is not rated for overhead lifting. Our [guide](/blog/ratchet-strap-vs-chain-and-binder) covers it in more detail.

faqs.q: What are the typical applications of the Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm)?
faqs.a: The Ratchet Strap — 1″ (25 mm) is used to secure loads on trucks, trailers and flatbeds and to lash equipment in transport, within the lashing capacity on its label. It is not for overhead lifting.
